breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retained and expanded upon the thin-walled tube approximation, stating 'Model the hollow circular shaft as a thin-walled closed tube,' introducing a mean radius rm = 26 mm, and referencing 'mean-area shear-flow relation' and 'thin-walled tube theory.' This directly contradicts the ground truth, which uses only the exact thick-walled torsion formula J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32 without any thin-walled approximation. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
